decisions.reason: As a newly launched product close to the core offer and already given its own webpage, it is likely to be retained because the firm has visibly committed to it and can justify giving it more time in a growing market.

Although only mentioned on the website, this automation-related product fits the firm's announced direction toward more automation and therefore management is likely to continue backing it despite any early uncertainty.

This product is still close to the established business, so escalation of commitment supports keeping it, but its lower public visibility makes it somewhat easier to drop than the more prominently presented launches.
Because it is adjacent to the firm's existing formwork business and was presented on its own page, management is likely to persist with it rather than reverse course after only about a year.
The product appears to be an incremental extension of the established range with visible market presentation, which makes continued support more likely than withdrawal in the near term.
This launch is close to the core business and thus likely to be kept for now, but its relatively limited website prominence means it has the highest chance of being discontinued among the six.
